_about: The landing page (#home, the page you land on): hero, the Method card and the About card. "How the three sources fit together" and "What we found in Sisal" are in content/triangulation.json; the picture of code in the Method card is "codeImage" in content/texts.json. Built by js/landing.js. Images: a path in the repo (img/ or data/vegetation/).

hero.title: Sisal Mangrove Monitor
hero.text: Sisal Mangrove Monitor puts three views of the mangrove side by side: satellite data, climate data, and the people of Sisal.

buttons.label: Run it on your own area

method.title: Method
method.text: This page explains the methods behind the research pages and gives the code to run the same analyses on your own data, location and question.

columns.label: Who
columns.text: TU Delft MDP × UNAM Sisal, 2026. A team of six from strategic product design, applied earth sciences and aerospace engineering.

columns.label: Data
columns.text: Landsat 5, 7, 8 and 9 (via Google Earth Engine), Sentinel-2 (base map), Global Mangrove Watch, ERA5 and ERA5-Land, HYCOM, satellite altimetry, and HURDAT2 (NOAA National Hurricane Center).

columns.label: Status
columns.text: Beta. Areas are mapped, not yet validated in the field.

columns.label: Where
columns.text: Sisal, on the north coast of the Yucatán Peninsula, Mexico.
